questions.question: What does Proverbs 24 warn against envying?
options: The poor, and the ease of their lives
The wise, and the honor they receive
Evil men, and being with them
Kings, and the splendor of their courts
questions.answer: Evil men, and being with them

questions.question: What does Proverbs 24 say about the righteous falling?
options: Though they fall seven times, they rise again
Once fallen, they stay down forever
They never fall, for God upholds them
When they fall, they are soon forgotten
questions.answer: Though they fall seven times, they rise again

questions.question: Proverbs 24 says if you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.
By _____ a house is built, and by understanding it is established.
A righteous man may fall seven times, yet he still _____ up.
